text: A running key is a long text written under the message. Sanborn might have used something he wrote himself: his 1989 letter to CIA staff, the 1991 dedication pages, or his 2025 open letter.
Drawn for the 1989 letter at its first offset on the sculpture's table: 2 of the 24 known places come out right.
All three texts, every offset, both directions, 390 tables: never fewer than 15 misses of 24, the same as shuffled coppers searched the same way.
